title: Invoice
description: The invoice's identity, its parties, its dates and currency, and an optional tax and notes.

name.title: Name
name.description: The legal or trading name, as printed.

address.title: Address
address.description: The postal address, one printed line per element.

email.title: Email
email.description: The address invoices are sent from or to.

tax_id.title: Tax ID
tax_id.description: A VAT, GST or other tax registration number, printed as given.

number.title: Invoice number
number.description: The invoice's unique reference, as printed.

issue_date.title: Issue date
issue_date.description: The date the invoice is issued, as YYYY-MM-DD.

due_date.title: Due date
due_date.description: The date payment is due, as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave it out to print no due date.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The ISO 4217 code every amount is in, such as USD, EUR or GBP.

seller.title: Seller
seller.description: Who issues the invoice and is paid.

buyer.title: Buyer
buyer.description: Who the invoice is billed to.

tax.title: Tax
tax.description: One tax applied to the subtotal. Leave it out to print no tax line.

label.title: Label
label.description: The tax's name on the invoice, such as VAT or Sales tax. Tax when left out.

rate.title: Rate
rate.description: The rate as a percentage of the subtotal: 20 means 20%.

payment_terms.title: Payment terms
payment_terms.description: How to pay: bank details, a payment link's text, or terms such as Net 30.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: A short message printed at the foot of the invoice.
